name: @spicadust/exa-cli
description: Unofficial command-line interface for the Exa API. Not affiliated with Exa.

scripts.build:bun:all: for t in bun-darwin-arm64 bun-linux-x64 bun-linux-arm64 bun-windows-x64; do bun build src/cli.ts --compile --target=$t --outfile dist-bin/exa-${t#bun-}; done
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

author: Qian Zhang
